high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter feed displaying two tweets. The top tweet is retweeted by Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw and originates from @TIME. It highlights Gabby Thomas, who is described as a Harvard graduate and epidemiologist who has just won an Olympic bronze medal. The tweet includes a photo of Gabby Thomas, wearing a purple and white athletic uniform with "THOMAS" written on the front. The URL "time.com" is provided for more information. The second tweet is from the official account of the Kolkata Knight Riders cricket team (@KKRi...), posted 6 hours prior to the screenshot.
